data.long_meaning: From the Persian word 'daryā' meaning 'sea'. This name symbolizes the deep emotions and experiences of life, often associated with the sea and its endless depths. The name Daria carries the meaning “Sea of sorrow” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Daria usually hope their child will grow to embody sea of sorrow and live with faith, good character and purpose.
